description: By the 1980s, the old José María Root group is trying to build adult lives rather than merely imagine them. Camilo's first novel and Eva's growing career expose class, money and ambition problems in their relationship; Salcedo's addiction, Pabón's love life and the AIDS crisis reshape the group around them. A three-year separation, Eva's return and a film project bring the friends together again, until political violence involving M-19 forces them to confront how far Colombia and their own lives have changed.

s04e01.description: Camilo's first novel angers his friends because they recognize private parts of their lives in his fiction, forcing him to defend what he has turned into material. Eva uses a discussion of Fellini's Amarcord to push the group toward reconciliation, while Luisa and Rodrigo move out of the house on 364 because Martín's cocaine use has made living there impossible and Vandalia takes the vacant room.

s04e02.description: Eva visits the Dominican Republic's embassy while researching activist Abigail Mejía and is trapped when M-19 guerrillas seize the building and its diplomatic hostages. Camilo covers the crisis from outside and the old group mobilizes around Eva's safety until she is released, making national political violence part of their adult lives rather than a classroom argument.

s04e03.description: Eva and Camilo begin living together at 364, but Vandalia's cocaine operation brings police attention and places everyone in the house at risk. After a raid destroys the drugs, the tenants compensate Vandalia and force him out, while Rosario works on creating a school that can properly serve Janet and Eva and Camilo decide they need a home of their own.

s04e04.description: Searching for an apartment exposes the financial gap between Eva and Camilo, especially after Eva's father cuts off support because she is living with him. Unpaid household bills push the friends into a television game show for prize money; Eva deliberately gives up the win when competition starts damaging the group, and Lucy returns to Bogotá.

s04e05.description: Money problems continue testing Eva and Camilo until they reach a workable truce over how they will share adult responsibilities. Lucy moves into 364, Rosario and Janet leave for Spain to pursue Janet's education, and Eva travels with Gustavo to Cauca for a yagé ceremony that both hope will resolve unfinished parts of their pasts.

s04e06.description: In Cauca, Gustavo confronts the father who abused him and the yagé ritual gives him a clearer sense of the life he wants to build. Eva experiences a vision of her deceased mother that helps her make peace with the loss, while Camilo and José work together on a story about an aging wrestler and repair some of their own strained relationship.

s04e07.description: Eva takes a job selling cars and learns that she is pregnant, prompting both families to rally around the couple as they prepare a nursery and imagine parenthood. The fragile optimism collapses after an argument over their lost dog and a collision with a drunk driver causes Eva to miscarry, leaving the family to recover from the loss together.

s04e08.description: Estela returns to Bogotá as a poet writing openly about sex, and Eva tries to help her find a publisher while Camilo reacts critically to the work. Estela moves into 364 and begins an affair with Salcedo before leaving again; Lucy experiments with marijuana, and by graduation in 1982 Camilo secures work writing for television.

s04e09.description: Camilo becomes a television sitcom writer and Eva works as a translator while their friends' adult lives diverge sharply. Gustavo builds a theater career and a relationship with Hugo, Rodrigo grows insecure about Luisa's medical profession, Álvaro is fired and joins the Acuña brothers in a robbery before surrendering, and Salcedo's cocaine use ends in an overdose.

s04e10.description: After surviving his overdose, Salcedo enters a church group and falls in love with novice Mónica, while Rodrigo and Luisa repair the strain in their marriage. Hugo's former partner is dying from AIDS, forcing Pabón and the group to confront the epidemic and its surrounding prejudice; during Eva's work trip with Scott, Camilo begins an affair with Marcela and Eva catches them.

s04e11.description: Three years later, the group has scattered into established careers and relationships when Eva returns to Colombia for Antonia's birthday accompanied by Scott. Camilo reacts badly, later apologizes and recognizes that his feelings for Eva remain unresolved, while Salcedo supports Mónica as they decide to build a life together without children.

s04e12.description: Rodrigo and Luisa are caught inside the Palace of Justice during the M-19 siege; Rodrigo returns, but Luisa disappears after entering military custody. The friends channel their grief into making a film, Marcela ends her relationship with Camilo, and Eva and Camilo reunite; the story closes as Antonia becomes a student at José María Root, carrying the group into another generation.
